fixed_short_description: Retaining pin ejected under tension near rigger
narrative: During heavy lift operations on Deck Rigging Floor, the shackle retaining pin came out at high speed and passed near the rigger. The rigger was positioned within line of trajectory.
corrective_action: Work stopped immediately. Retaining clip replaced with double-locking split pin assembly.
preventive_action: Mandatory pre-use inspection of shackle pins across all deck units.

functional_location_description: High Pressure Gas Line Valve Manifold
fixed_short_description: Subtle hydrocarbon gas hiss detected near flange
narrative: Operator noticed minor hydrocarbon weeping and localized gas hiss at flange connection during routine rounds. Gas test confirmed 5% LEL near valve manifold.
corrective_action: Area cordoned off, permit issued for flange retightening under nitrogen purge.
preventive_action: Thermal imaging and bolt torque audit scheduled for HCU-2 manifold.
